text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You really went and made every single one of those revisions?
And here I was reflecting on whether I went way too harsh with my feedback...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize for the trouble, but could you please take another look?" I asked, resubmitting the proposal—
the training regimen plan crafted specifically for Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had polished it as much as I could, but after endless rewrites, it was far from pristine.
What's more, it was surely still full of green, amateur mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
...Man, ever since summer training camp wrapped up, you've been like a whole new person.
Alright, deal! I'll go over it, so give me a bit.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, buying a ton of stuff again today, huh...?! Are all of those reference books?
You're really putting your heart and soul into making that training plan.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about this, though? Weren't you complaining earlier?
That if you only ever take a serious approach, you'll just keep getting turned down—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: And that you were worrying over whether you should learn to pitch things in a fun, trendy way that clicks with girls their age?
choice_data_list: Well... yeah. But I'm done second-guessing myself.
Well... yeah. But I'm done second-guessing myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded, firmly gripping the document covered in red ink and sticky notes.
...Even if this is all I have, I'll stick to being earnest. I'll push forward with pure sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because I don't have time to give up on myself.
choice_data_list: I'll do it earnestly, one step at a time. Steady and sure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—finally, my absolute best, wholehearted training plan was complete!
choice_data_list: (All that's left is to have her read it...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I entered the email address listed in the student registry and attached the plan file.
Now then, how should I phrase the message...
choice_data_list: Um, the message... What should I write...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Craft and I were talking about hitting up that trendy crepe shop after this.
If you'd like to join us, Messiah-san... Hm? Did you get a notification?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It appears I have received an email.
I apologize for interrupting our conversation, but please allow me to check it briefly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...'Dear Air Messiah-sama, I hope this message finds you well.
Please pardon my reaching out out of the blue during your busy schedule'—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 'My name is <username>, a rookie trainer. While I realize this may be an overly forward request, there is a document I would deeply appreciate if you could review—'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Um, is that from a trainer hoping to scout you... maybe?
Even so... gosh, that's an exceptionally polite email.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ............Yes, it truly is.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san, I am truly sorry.
I appreciate your kind invitation, but I must take a rain check on the crepes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Something has arrived that I must look over without delay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The following day.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! No way... Did it come?!
It's here! A reply from Air Messiah-san!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
'Thank you for reaching out with such courtesy.
I have thoroughly reviewed all of the materials you provided.'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
'Accordingly, I would welcome the opportunity to meet with you in person at a later date.
I would be most grateful if you could let me know your availability.'

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: O-Ooh... Th-That's an incredibly formal reply, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After exchanging a few more messages with Air Messiah, we scheduled an appointment.
And then, exactly five minutes before the agreed time—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Good day to you.
I am Air Messiah, here for our scheduled meeting.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sat facing Air Messiah, who had entered with immaculate posture.
...We were both so stiff that it felt more like a formal job interview, but still.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, as I mentioned in my email,
I have thoroughly reviewed all of the materials you shared with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: As well as your closing words—'I would truly love the chance to become your trainer.'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to keep you in suspense, so I will be direct.
Trainer-san—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If you would have me,
would you be willing to sign a training contract with me?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As I shared previously,
my ultimate objective is victory in the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I understand full well that achieving this will be no simple feat.
Particularly because—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Those aiming for the Tiara route who will likely debut in my generation, led by Cesario-san,
are all formidable contenders brimming with unmatched talent.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
'Standing alone at the pinnacle with none to rival'... 
To reach the true essence of racing, I am still sorely lacking.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even so, however—my conviction remains unchanged.
My strength lies in being earnest. In being steadfast.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And you understand the profound value of being just that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...That meticulously crafted regimen, which took me over two full hours to read through,
conveyed that truth to me unmistakably.
choice_data_list: ...I'm sorry to have taken up so much of your time...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Please, do not apologize. It was time well spent.
And... um.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You may speak to me more casually from now on.
...After all, we will be walking this path together.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you,
Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Yeah. I look forward to working with you too... Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Now that the paperwork has been submitted... our contract is officially sealed, then.
We can discuss future arrangements on another day, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san. Forgive me for bringing this up so suddenly, but...
might I ask for your advice on something?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...As I mentioned earlier,
moving forward, I must compete against extraordinarily gifted Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, steadfastness is my forte, but—at times,
I believe it will be necessary to break out of my comfort zone and shatter my shell.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...And so, as a first step toward that,
a sort of training in taking bold leaps—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of switching my daily protein shake to an exceedingly rare
'Pickled Plum' flavor... What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Is that really... taking a bold leap? While it certainly is rare, it doesn't quite seem outlandishly daring enough—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Is it still too mundane, after all?
In that case, please offer a suggestion of your own, Trainer-san. Something truly radical.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...How, um... how radical is that really?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two earnest souls paired together... with an overly matched, cautious stride.
Yet steadily, step by step, our journey toward our dream began.
